biggest_catch: Pouch pays you nothing — it applies voucher codes at checkout. Coupon savings are discounts, not earnings, and there is no official payout method, minimum, or schedule.
catches: Pouch is a voucher-code/coupon extension (UK-focused, acquired by Global Savings Group); it has no user cashback or rewards balance.
No payout mechanism exists: no minimum threshold, no payout method, no payment timing.
Savings depend on finding valid codes — many codes are expired or don't apply to your basket.
The extension tracks the shopping sites you visit to surface codes — a privacy trade-off with zero earnings on the other side.

c1.evidence: Pouch (JoinPouch) is a real UK voucher-code browser extension, acquired by Global Savings Group; it is a coupon tool, not a cashback program.

c2.evidence: FAIL — no official terms describe any user payout; the product is described everywhere as automatically finding and applying voucher codes.

c3.evidence: Free to download and use; no upfront fee — but there is also no payout.

c4.evidence: FAIL — no concrete payout mechanism exists in official terms: no minimum, no payout method, no timing. Coupon savings are not earnings.

eligibility: Anyone can install the free extension; there is no earnings account to be eligible for.
notes: REJECT is a verifiability verdict, not a scam flag: Pouch is a legitimate coupon extension, but coupon savings are discounts — not a payout program — so it cannot satisfy the concrete-payout checklist. Do not list this route as verified unless Pouch launches an official user cashback payout program.

s1.note: No earnings eligibility exists; anyone can use the free coupon extension.
